title: [GDN/Qwen3-Next] Avoid SSM and conv state copy for speculative decoding - up to 9.47% e2e speedup

labels.name: run-ci
labels.description: CI: run the baseline test suite on this PR

body: ## Motivation Replace intermediate state buffers with last_steps for speculative decoding. All conv and SSM states are now lazily updated inside their kernels based on last_steps, removing state-copy sync operations during post-target-verification and simplifying the update path. ## Modifications ### Speculative Decoding State Management * Replaced usage of `intermediate_states_buffer` and `intermediate_conv_window_cache` with a new `last_steps` tensor, which tracks the last accepted step index for each sequence in speculative decoding. This change is reflected in both the Triton kernel and the Python wrapper functions, streamlining state tracking. * Updated speculative state update logic in `update_mamba_state_after_mtp_verify` to set `last_steps` directly, removing the need to scatter intermediate states into caches which is slow due to cpu<->gpu sync ### Triton Kernel and Interface Changes * Modified Triton kernel signatures and logic to accept `last_steps_ptr` instead of intermediate state buffers, and adjusted stride calculations to support the new state layout. * Updated stride and shape calculations in convolution state handling to support the new speculative decoding state layout. ### Hybrid Linear Attention Backend * Refactored the hybrid linear attention backend to use `last_steps` for speculative decoding, removing references to intermediate state caches and updating the logic for state updates and acceptance. ### Mamba Radix Cache * This PR maintains full backward compatibility with existing Mamba radix/prefix caches. As long as the last_steps tensor is transferred from the radix cache when initializing a new sequence’s Mamba cache, both SSM state updates and convolution state reconstruction will remain correct. ## Accuracy Tests Before and after the PR, gsm8k stays at 0.95 for TP4 MTP 448, TP4 MTP 538, TP4 MTP 314 and TP4 w/o MTP ## Benchmarking and Profiling on H200x1 Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct-FP8 ``` from sglang.srt.entrypoints.http_server import launch_server from sglang.srt.server_args import prepare_server_args if __name__ == "__main__": # Simulate CLI arguments (excluding the script name) args = [ "--model-path", "Qwen/Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct-FP8", "--speculative-algo", "NEXTN", "--speculative-num-steps", "3", # "5", # "4", "--speculative-eagle-topk", "1", # "3", # "4", "--speculative-num-draft-tokens", "4", # "8", # "8", ] server_args = prepare_server_args(args) launch_server(server_args) ``` ### Spec Decoding 314: 251.76 tok/s -> 275.59 tok/s - 9.47% e2e faster +-------------+--------+------------+-----------------+ | Latency (s) | Tokens | Acc Length | Speed (token/s) | +-------------+--------+------------+-----------------+ | 2.034 | 512 | 3.241 | 251.76 | +-------------+--------+------------+-----------------+ -> +-------------+--------+------------+-----------------+ | Latency (s) | Tokens | Acc Length | Speed (token/s) | +-------------+--------+------------+-----------------+ | 1.858 | 512 | 3.391 | 275.59 | +-------------+--------+------------+-----------------+ ### Spec Decoding 538: 250.28 tok/s -> 260.86 tok/s - 4.23% e2e faster +-------------+--------+------------+-----------------+ | Latency (s) | Tokens | Acc Length | Speed (token/s) | +-------------+--------+------------+-----------------+ | 2.046 | 512 | 4.197 | 250.28 | +-------------+--------+------------+-----------------+ -> +-------------+--------+------------+-----------------+ | Latency (s) | Tokens | Acc Length | Speed (token/s) | +-------------+--------+------------+-----------------+ | 1.963 | 512 | 4.267 | 260.86 | +-------------+--------+------------+-----------------+ ### Spec Decoding 448: 272.54 tok/s -> 272.73 tok/s +-------------+--------+------------+-----------------+ | Latency (s) | Tokens | Acc Length | Speed (token/s) | +-------------+--------+------------+-----------------+ | 1.879 | 512 | 4.267 | 272.54 | +-------------+--------+------------+-----------------+ -> +-------------+--------+------------+-----------------+ | Latency (s) | Tokens | Acc Length | Speed (token/s) | +-------------+--------+------------+-----------------+ | 1.877 | 512 | 4.129 | 272.73 | +-------------+--------+------------+-----------------+ ## Benchmarking and Profiling on H100x4 Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct ``` from sglang.srt.entrypoints.http_server import launch_server from sglang.srt.server_args import prepare_server_args if __name__ == "__main__": # Simulate CLI arguments (excluding the script name) args = [ "--model-path", "Qwen/Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct", "--tp", "4", "--speculative-algo", "NEXTN", "--speculative-num-steps", "3", # "5", # "4", "--speculative-eagle-topk", "1", # "3", # "4", "--speculative-num-draft-tokens", "4", # "8", # "8", ] server_args = prepare_server_args(args) launch_server(server_args) ``` ### Spec Decoding 314: 317.01 tok/s -> 333.60 tok/s - 5.23% e2e faster +-------------+--------+------------+-----------------+ | Latency (s) | Tokens | Acc Length | Speed (token/s) | +-------------+--------+------------+-----------------+ | 1.615 | 512 | 3.346 | 317.01 | +-------------+--------+------------+-----------------+ -> +-------------+--------+------------+-----------------+ | Latency (s) | Tokens | Acc Length | Speed (token/s) | +-------------+--------+------------+-----------------+ | 1.535 | 512 | 3.346 | 333.60 | +-------------+--------+------------+-----------------+ ### Spec Decoding 538: 325.60 tok/s -> 337.06 tok/s - 3.85% e2e faster +-------------+--------+------------+-----------------+ | Latency (s) | Tokens | Acc Length | Speed (token/s) | +-------------+--------+------------+-----------------+ | 1.572 | 512 | 4.267 | 325.60 | +-------------+--------+------------+-----------------+ -> +-------------+--------+------------+-----------------+ | Latency (s) | Tokens | Acc Length | Speed (token/s) | +-------------+--------+------------+-----------------+ | 1.519 | 512 | 4.267 | 337.06 | +-------------+--------+------------+-----------------+ ### Spec Decoding 448: 335.34 tok/s -> 350.82 tok/s - 4.62% e2e faster +-------------+--------+------------+-----------------+ | Latency (s) | Tokens | Acc Length | Speed (token/s) | +-------------+--------+------------+-----------------+ | 1.527 | 512 | 4.231 | 335.34 | +-------------+--------+------------+-----------------+ -> +-------------+--------+------------+-----------------+ | Latency (s) | Tokens | Acc Length | Speed (token/s) | +-------------+--------+------------+-----------------+ | 1.459 | 512 | 4.231 | 350.82 | +-------------+--------+------------+-----------------+ ### update_mamba_state_after_mtp_verify: 339.03us -> 50.260us - 6.75x faster ``` python3 -m sglang.test.send_one --profile ``` Speed-up thanks to no conv state or SSM state copy at end of each round of target verify. Instead, both conv_update and ssm_update kernel will pick up the last verified index from last verify -> ## Checklist - [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.ai/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit). - [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.ai/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests). - [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.ai/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). - [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.ai/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.ai/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
